title: Can LLMs Reliably Annotate Bioassay Metadata to Improve Data Readiness?
abstract: arXiv:2610.01616v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The emergence of foundation models for molecular property prediction requires a high degree of AI data readiness, including reliable metadata annotation. However, both public repositories and industrial screening databases suffer from missing, inconsistent, or conflated assay annotations. In this work, we quantify the extent of missing annotations in PubChem for the BioAssay Ontology (BAO) assay format and physical detection method fields and investigate whether open-source and proprietary large language models (LLMs) can reliably predict and audit metadata annotations directly from the assay text. In our assessment, we found that the annotation coverage across PubChem's $\sim$2 million bioassays is critically sparse, 36\% lacking an assay format, 89\% a BioAssay type, and >99.9\% any BAO-mapped assay format or detection technology term. This motivates the need for automated test-metadata curation. Using evaluation sets derived from Pu

translated_title: 大语言模型能否可靠地标注生物测定元数据以提升数据就绪度？
translated_abstract: 分子性质预测基础模型的出现需要高度的AI数据就绪度，其中包括可靠的元数据标注。然而，无论是公共数据库还是工业筛选数据库，都存在测定标注缺失、不一致或混淆的问题。在这项工作中，我们量化了PubChem中BioAssay本体（BAO）测定格式和物理检测方法字段标注缺失的严重程度，并研究了开源及专有大语言模型（LLM）能否直接从测定文本中可靠地预测和审计元数据标注。在我们的评估中，我们发现PubChem约200万个生物测定的标注覆盖率严重不足：36%缺少测定格式，89%缺少生物测定类型，超过99.9%缺少任何BAO映射的测定格式或检测技术术语。这凸显了对自动化测定元数据整理的需求。使用从Pu（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本研究量化了PubChem生物测定元数据标注的严重缺失问题（超过99.9%缺少BAO映射的测定格式或检测技术术语），并探索利用大语言模型直接从测定文本中自动预测和审计元数据标注，以提升AI数据就绪度。
en_tdlr: This study quantifies the critical sparsity of bioassay metadata annotations in PubChem (e.g., >99.9% lacking BAO-mapped assay format or detection technology terms) and investigates whether LLMs can reliably predict and audit metadata annotations directly from assay text to improve AI data readiness.
